incident: Theseus v0.2.2 (#35, found in review of BenchBox #3978, fixed in #37): a substitute model skipped the slot's own capacity check, so a load above the primary's window ran in the smaller slot.
message: Substitute a served candidate when the primary is not served

defects.title: A substituted reviewer skips the slot's own capacity check
defects.detail: When providers.resolve returns a substitute, the load check against the slot capacity is skipped, so a load above the primary's capacity runs in the smaller slot instead of escalating.
